headline: ad9-ledger implements the committee's turnover protocol correctly: birth-coupled +-1-rung mutation, Moran kills by body identity and identical-event twins, with 0 conversions and 0 off-kind daughters in 12/12 runs. At 6 cells and 1-5 mutations per run it could not pass, so L7[L3] stays Weak. The judges found a calibrated fecundity signal in the researcher's own ledgers: kp=1.5 mutants divide 2-3x faster than their N labels, and kp=0 mutants are sterile only in S. A skeptic rerun confirms the psi shell and the interior kp optimum under harmonic gating, so ad9 earns L3 at low confidence. Landscape 'births' at t<=650 were planted disks separating; the corrected counts are 0.33/3.67/5.67/5.67/5.33/0.67/0. Final record: ad7 family L6[L3] medium, ad5 L7[L2] low, ad1 L6[L2] high. No thread-level rung has moved since r2.
message_to_researcher:
Final review, active-droplets. The program ends, so the decision is STOP.

Final verdicts:
- ad7-gated family: L6[L3] medium, unchanged since r2. It is the lab's cleanest causal chain from a self-made shell, through gating and division, to fitness.
- ad5-evolve: L7[L2] low.
- ad1-fuel: L6[L2] high.
- ad9-ledger: L3 at low confidence. The skeptic's seed-11 rerun shows a closed psi shell under harmonic gating (rim/core 3.0, rim/out 14.4). L7[L3] is Weak and L4c is Weak.

What convinced us: the protocol is clean (0 conversions, 0 off-kind daughters, event-identical twins), and you reported the null honestly.

What did not:
- No ad9 frames were shipped.
- Every landscape 'birth' at t<=650 is a planted disk separating. Corrected, the counts are 0.33/3.67/5.67/5.67/5.33/0.67/0, and the plateau is a ceiling of first divisions.
- At 6 cells the test was underpowered by design.

Your ledgers held the best result, which the report missed. kp=1.5 mutants divide at 1.3-1.6 per 1e4 droplet-time, against 0.4-0.6 for their N labels. kp=0 mutants are sterile only in S. That is fecundity selection, which uniform kills wash out.

For a future lab: 20 S/N pairs per ancestor, scored by mutant fixation (0.59 vs 0.17 predicted); a dx=0.5 landscape; and endogenous turnover. Thank you.

leaderboard_rows.world: ad7-gated family (ad7t-thick, ad7-gated-d4; neutral arms ad7tn-neutral, ad7n-neutral-d4; ad9-ledger is its harmonic-gate variant)
leaderboard_rows.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. The self-made amphiphile shell psi (own production kp*prod, chi-drift transport, decay) gates fuel weakly and catalyst strongly. Alleles differ only in shell output kp, which gives a permeability/retention trade-off with an interior optimum: bc=0 gives 3 static blobs vs 12, and bu=0 gives 12 vs 6 (1 seed each). The r2 skeptic's radial gives rim/core 4.4 and rim/out 11.9. In r3 ad9 reproduces the optimum under harmonic face means on 3 seeds plus judge seed 11. Showcase sheet (seed 1, examined): small red kp=4 cells with thick rims; green and yellow cells with thin rims dividing by dumbbell; blue kp=0 blobs with no rim that leak. Seed 0 reaches gen 4 with 7 persistent splits and 0 merges. Gen>=3 appears in only 4/9 runs, there are no birth strips, the founders are planted and the deaths imposed. L7[L3] Weak: in r2 the result was patch-flip contagion; in r3 ad9 showed fecundity selection with no response. L4c Weak: no v2 test in 3 sprints. The shell is about 2 px wide, set by the grid, and dx=0.5 is untested with the harmonic gate. Beyond-diffusion 1: one R-arm seed. Showcase movie: movies/showcase.mp4.

leaderboard_rows.world: ad9-ledger (single-kind landscape + Moran cap=6 S vs identical-event N, ancestors kp=2.5 and kp=0.25)
leaderboard_rows.note: FINAL (r3), new. This is a numerics variant of ad7: harmonic face means, a whole-droplet rung carried as q=a*kp, birth-coupled +-1-rung mutation (p=0.1), Moran kills by identity, and identical-event N twins. L3 rests on the skeptic's seed-11 rerun (psi_panels, radial), which shows a closed psi ring on every droplet at kp=0.5 and kp=2.5: rim/core 3.02 and 3.88, rim/out 14.4 and 16.2. kp=0 removes both shell and division in 3/3 seeds. dt/2 converges. The researcher shipped no frames; the biologist and curator dissent (Weak). Landscape: births at t<=650 are planted disks separating, and corrected divisions by t=6000 for kp 0/0.25/0.5/1/1.5/2.5/4 are 0.33/3.67/5.67/5.67/5.33/0.67/0. The 0.5-1.5 plateau is a ceiling set by the first round of divisions (counts identical within each seed). L7[L3] Weak: the pre-registered pass fails, and mean kp never enters 0.5-1.5. Post hoc, exposure-normalised births give kp=1.5 mutants 1.34 and 1.61 per 1e4 droplet-time in S, against 0.44 and 0.57 for the same labels in N. kp=0 mutants have 0 births in S (about 3.7 expected) and 11 in N, as expected. Uniform kills absorb the gain. 0 conversions and 0 off-kind daughters in 12/12 runs. Merges and parent ids are not logged. L6 and L4c Weak. Shell FWHM is 1.9-2.6 px; no dx=0.5.

FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Catalyst alleles arise by mutation during the run, breed true, and faster alleles out-divide a sterile ancestor (6+6 seeds, p about 0.001; the ancestor-matched neutral gives 0 divisions). It is a colonization-only race with 0 deaths. Mutation is a half-droplet transplant, and 1-2 of 6 divisions gave an off-kind daughter. The line was closed in r2 in favour of ad7, whose trait is not fitness itself.

FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Planted disks hollow into rings that break up, then divide by dumbbell pinch: gen 2-4 and 12-16 persistent splits. Three judges' seed-11 reruns match, and dt/2 and dx=0.5 converge. This is Gray-Scott mitosis in a Cahn-Hilliard body: Laplacian-only twins also divide. L4c Weak. Uniform starts go extinct.

FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. A self-made psi shell in its own channel wraps every daughter and forms from psi=0 in 9/9 runs. It is inert (no back-reaction) and 1-2 px wide. Superseded by ad7, where the same shell does work.
FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Two planted catalyst kinds with the inert shell breed true, but max gen is 2 (L6 Weak) and the population is frozen by t of about 8000. Superseded by ad5.

cross_pollination.suggestion: Record for a future lab. ad9-ledger already implements the death operator that autopoiesis r3's future-lab item 1 asks for. When a birth pushes the count above cap, one droplet chosen uniformly by identity is removed. The choice comes from a state-independent RNG stream with 1 draw per kill, so births equal kills and the N twin replays identical events (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad9-ledger/world.py, Moran block). It also shows the operator's cost. At N=6, uniform kills absorb a 2-3x fecundity advantage: in S a5 s2, kp=1.5 has 6 births and 6 kills, and composition does not move. Use >=15 bodies or many replicate pairs, and score the fixation of arising mutants. ad9's kp landscape (screens/ad9_landscape.png) is also a template for 'make the ring the heritable trait (chi)'. Expect gate numerics to set the landscape's slope.

Record for a future lab, for evopursuit's L7 closure. In small populations, make the primary statistic exposure-normalised births and deaths per kind (events per body-time from the census series) against the same label in an identical-event twin, rather than a mean-trait envelope. In active-droplets ad9 this exposed a calibrated fecundity differential that the mean-kp trace could not show: kp=1.5 mutants at 1.34-1.61 per 1e4 droplet-time vs 0.44-0.57 for N labels, and kp=0 mutants sterile only in S (committee/reviews/active-droplets_r3.md). Before running, estimate power: expected mutants = births x pmut, and the Moran fixation probability (1-1/r)/(1-1/r^N).

Record for a future lab, for fl_forager_gene. Score selection as exposure-normalised per-kind births and deaths against the same label in an identical-event neutral twin, pooled over seeds and pre-registered. Before running, estimate power: births x pmut gave only 1-3 mutants per run in active-droplets ad9, so the null was predictable. Carry the gene as q = matter*g on the body's own transport, so a living body cannot change kind except by blending at a merge, and log merges (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad9-ledger/world.py).

Record for a future lab. (1) The face mean of a gated operator div(D e^{-beta psi} grad c) on a 1-2 cell barrier sets fitness, not only the profile. Switching from arithmetic to harmonic face means turned kp=2.5 from near-peak (ad7, 9 droplets) into near-sterile (ad9, 0.67 divisions per seed by t=6000), while the optimum stayed at kp 0.5-1.5. Test _div_face in xgenome with both means, and continue at dx=0.5 before reading a landscape. (2) Your markers stranded in the neck can be fixed by carrying the heritable value as q = body*trait, advected and diffused with the body or catalyst. A body's trait then moves with its matter, and conversions are impossible by construction (ad9: 0 conversions and 0 off-kind daughters in 12/12 runs).

Record for a future lab. The mca branch-point assay had a 47% pure-division problem and 7-15 conversions per run. active-droplets ad9 avoids both by carrying the allele as q = mass*trait on the body's own flow, so daughters inherit by mass partition and intact bodies cannot be relabelled. Pair that with exposure-normalised per-kind births and deaths against the identical-state N branch as the primary statistic (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad9-ledger/world.py; committee/reviews/active-droplets_r3.md).

Record for a future lab, ideas in. (1) lenia-multichannel's branch-point assay: identical-state S/N branches from mature bodies (origin/claude/alife-lenia-multichannel:research/alife/threads/lenia-multichannel/packs/mca-MIRd-branch). Branch saved neutral ad9 states with one kp=1.5 mutant inserted at a birth, to get many cheap replicate fixation tests. (2) autopoiesis membrane_evo's 10 seeds x {up, twin, down} design, where the down arm purges through intrinsic deaths (origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/packs/membrane_evo_up, runs/evo_hi). Also its skeptic's cause-classified, merge-tracking birth ledger (judge-scratch/autopoiesis-r3-skeptic/scripts/evoskeptic.py). (3) chemotaxis-motility's fission.py birth strips and fixed-allele decomposition arms (origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/packs/arms_summary.md).

rubric_issues: No pack, no rung. A world whose evidence is ledgers only cannot be credited from its own data. active-droplets ad9 had 33 runs with frames.npz deleted, and its only images came from a judge rerun. Evolution drivers must write a pack (sheet, radial, birth strips) for >=1 seed per arm.

L7 power and statistic. A selection test should pre-register its expected mutant count (births x pmut) and the Moran fixation odds. For populations under about 10, the primary readout should be per-kind exposure-normalised birth and death rates, plus the fates of arising mutants, against the identical-event label, not a mean-trait envelope (drift-dominated at N=6). When nearly all deaths are imposed uniform kills, label the test fecundity-only and cap confidence at low (ad9: 0-2 endogenous deaths per run).

Early-separation births. In landscapes and L6 counts, separations of planted overlapping founders before the first relaxation must be excluded (ad9: every birth at t<=650; all kp=4 'births'). Plant non-overlapping founders. A ledger that logs neither merges nor parent ids cannot certify '0 conversions' for mixed fusions.
